Maya R: Morning — async standup for PulseBridge onboarding escalation. TL;DR: webhook errors, certs needed, canary plan in flight.
Maya R: What I did: triaged spike, captured failing request IDs, opened infra ticket (INF-4123).
Maya R: Blockers: PulseBridge requires a customer-managed cert to finish VPC callbacks; no cert yet so private routing fails.
Maya R: Today: coordinate cert exchange, deploy 2% canary once certs live, validate end-to-end.
Tomas L: Got it. Can you paste the error traces? Also cc @Oliver P for routing/certs.
Maya R: logs (excerpt): ```2026-03-16T04:02:11Z ERROR callback /v1/ack 500 id=ab12c3 payload_size=827``` payload samples attached to CS ticket CS-7890.
Oliver P: I can create a temporary bypass rule to reduce user impact. Will need vault read to fetch cert once legal provides it.
Rachel G: Legal is expediting the cert exchange. They said they'll upload an encrypted S3 bundle with instructions by EOD PST.
cs-bot: Alert: PulseBridge webhook error spike detected (4:02–4:12 UTC) — 142 failures. Auto-ticket CS-7890 created.
Tomas L: For the canary, recommend starting at 2% traffic to a dedicated pool, monitor latency and 5xx rate for 10m, then bump to 20% if stable.
Maya R: Added rollout YAML in PR: ```rollout:
  strategy: canary
  initial_traffic_percent: 2
  metric_checks:
    - name: error_rate
      threshold: 0.5%
    - name: median_latency
      threshold_ms: 350``` PR: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/pulsebridge-onboarding/pull/317
Oliver P: I granted maya.redwood vault read for the cert path. Once Rachel posts the S3 link, I can fetch and install into staging.
Rachel G: S3 link posted in DM to Maya and Oliver. Compliance will append metadata after upload.
Maya R: If certs installed, I'll run the canary and validate callbacks. If not by 16:00 PT, we'll schedule a brief maintenance window with PulseBridge. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Tomas L: If maintenance is needed, prepare automatic fallback to hosted endpoints for 10% of users to keep critical flows alive.
Oliver P: I'll prepare rollback playbook and a simple toggle script to flip routing between private and hosted.
Maya R: Quick ask — who can review the PR after 12:30 PT? Need sign-off to start canary when certs are present.
Tomas L: I can review at 13:00 PT.
Rachel G: 12:45 PT works for me.
Oliver P: 13:15 PT but can leave inline comments earlier.
Maya R: Thanks all — I'll update CS-7890 with status and next steps after installs. End of thread.
